# clear_caches { #phasic.clear_caches }

```python
phasic.clear_caches(verbose=False)
```

Clear all caching.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**verbose**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Print information about cleared cache. Default: True

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from phasic import clear_caches()
>>> clear_caches()
```
